svg.title: Bytes an agent received: 1,157.5 KB raw versus 49.4 KB with justless (95.7% smaller, 23.4x) across 18 reproducible workloads.
svg.desc: Paired horizontal bars for the 14 largest workloads of 18 reproducible Wave 1-6 benchmarks on a linear 0 to 400 KB axis. rg -n "fn " src: 349.0 KB raw, 4.0 KB with justless (99%, 88.2x); read --outline: 267.2 KB raw, 2.3 KB with justless (99%, 114.4x); query + map + mask: 264.9 KB raw, 22.6 KB with justless (92%, 11.7x); kubectl logs: 45.9 KB raw, 1.1 KB with justless (98%, 41.2x); gh checks + audit: 33.0 KB raw, 564 B with justless (98%, 59.8x); gh api JSON: 30.2 KB raw, 3.6 KB with justless (88%, 8.3x); psql table: 27.5 KB raw, 4.0 KB with justless (85%, 6.8x); pytest: 19.7 KB raw, 741 B with justless (96%, 27.2x); docker build: 18.4 KB raw, 498 B with justless (97%, 37.8x); kubectl pods + desc: 18.3 KB raw, 1.6 KB with justless (92%, 11.8x); cargo test: 17.6 KB raw, 517 B with justless (97%, 34.9x); cargo tree: 15.7 KB raw, 1.5 KB with justless (90%, 10.5x); terraform plan: 14.6 KB raw, 1.3 KB with justless (91%, 11.1x); git diff: 12.2 KB raw, 490 B with justless (96%, 25.5x).
